name: spec-driven
description: Stack-agnostic spec-driven development workflow (specify, then plan, implement, verify). Available now: the spec-creator agent and /spec-driven:specify, which interview first and then write a behaviour spec (what, never how) with EARS acceptance criteria, module interactions, NFRs and untrusted-input rules; and the planner agent and /spec-driven:plan, which review the requirements and then write an implementation plan (contracts, work units with disjoint ownership per wave, skills, checks, traceability to the spec). Each writes only Markdown in its own folder (hook-enforced). And the implementer agent and /spec-driven:implement, which build an approved plan wave by wave (one implementer per unit, a check and a commit per wave, a read-only plan-verifier run at the end; never a push or a pull request); and the plan-verifier agent and /spec-driven:verify, which check the code against every plan item and spec criterion with file:line or command evidence and a PASS/FAIL/INCOMPLETE verdict. A Bash guard limits the implementer and the plan-verifier to read-only git and the project's checkCommand.
